map.note_body: This is not a simple continuous memory table. It is a logical address space defined by function code plus address range. VPP 31000~31999 appears in both the 0x03 and 0x04 systems, and event log 32768~42866 overlaps with SunSpec 40000~42000. AI parsing, cloud adaptation layers, and collector protocol stacks should not infer field meaning by address alone; they should use DTC, function code, address, protocol version, and Profile as a combined index.

applicability.vpp.lead: 0x03 address 30000 dynamically returns the device model DTC, which identifies the model type. The returned DTC must exist in the currently supported DTC SSOT.
applicability.vpp.summary: Flow: read 30000 → match the code in DTC SSOT → interpret VPP registers according to the matched model type.
applicability.vpp.notice: If a register row note explicitly states a DTC limit, that row note is authoritative. The DTC codes below are the currently supported list.
applicability.vpp.rule_1: The DTC SSOT lists VPP 0x03: 30000~32099 and VPP 0x04: 31000~31999 as shared register fields.
applicability.vpp.rule_2: VPP V2.05 defines address 30000 as “Device model (DTC)” and notes “see Table 3-1”.
applicability.vpp.rule_3: DTC codes in VPP V2.05 Appendix Table 3-1 must match the currently supported DTC SSOT.
applicability.vpp.field_note: Per-register applicability is determined by registers[].applicable_dtc_or_model and notes.
